name: Rival AXS E1
positioning: The mainstream fully wireless benchmark: easy electronic installation, but XDR, Flattop, DUB and DOT requirements can raise retrofit cost.
architecture: Fully wireless AXS control with removable batteries on each derailleur and coin cells in the levers.

weight.note: SRAM states the current family is 213 g lighter than its prior generation, but no cross-brand package total is used here.

battery: One removable AXS battery per installed derailleur plus lever coin cells; a 2x setup normally carries two interchangeable derailleur batteries.
controls_and_app: AXS app supports setup, personalization, battery state and firmware.
package_summary: A road conversion may need levers, RD, optional FD, one or two batteries, charger, calipers, cassette, Flattop chain, crank, DUB bottom bracket and rotors.

compatibility.freehub: XDR for the normal 10T-start road cassettes
compatibility.frame: No electronic wire route; verify XDR wheel and DUB/crank compatibility

china_price_status: No attributable exact mainland Rival AXS E1 package price captured in this batch.
caveats: Count the XDR freehub, Flattop chain, cassette, batteries, charger, DUB parts and DOT bleed equipment before comparing prices.
Road AXS hydraulic brakes use DOT fluid, not mineral oil.
